svg.text: One Next.js app serves the UI and the API; long work runs as durable Inngest functions that drive E2B sandboxes, AI Gateway models,

text.font-family: Excalifont1, Excalifont0, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: Browserbase browser checks, Supermemory memory and Resend email.

text.font-family: Excalifont1, Excalifont0, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif
Excalifont1, Excalifont0, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: • tRPC mutations enqueue work with inngest.send("agent/run" | "github/export"); Inngest then calls back into /api/inngest to run each durable step.

text.font-family: Excalifont1, Excalifont0, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: • Every server box reads and writes Postgres through Prisma; only the main arrows are drawn.

text.font-family: Excalifont1, Excalifont0, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: • export-github pushes with the user's OAuth token on the server; no credential ever enters a sandbox or the model context.

text.font-family: Excalifont1, Excalifont0, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: • Supermemory receives only the user's own message text (read in route, written in remember); Browserbase only the preview URL and rendered pages.

text.font-family: Excalifont1, Excalifont0, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: • Notification emails: run-agent and export-github queue notify/send; send-notification emails the user through Resend (project name and outcome only, never prompts or code).

text.font-family: Excalifont1, Excalifont0, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: • Editing: code.write saves a draft version and updates the running sandbox; Save version, or the next message, makes it a saved version.

text.font-family: Excalifont1, Excalifont0, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: /api/terminal runs one command at a time. Editing and the terminal both lock while an agent runs.
